nom: COSRX Red Rice Pore Peel Shot

segments.oily: Reports are split: one reviewer explicitly says it doesn't work on purely oily skin, since the skin's natural oil stops the product from pilling up as intended, while others with oily-leaning or hormonally oily skin report it helped reduce oiliness and clean pores.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one dealing with seasonal dryness and another with mature, dry skin, report a balanced, non-stripping exfoliation that smooths texture without leaving skin tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination skin with rosacea, report it exfoliates effectively without irritating their face.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone or reactive skin consistently report it is gentle and non-irritating, though one recommends starting with just once a week to avoid overdoing it.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who groups normal skin with combination and dry skin as suited to this product calls it amazing for all three.
segments.mature: The reviewer with mature, post-menopausal dry skin reports this is more balanced than other peel shots she's tried, delivering visible smoothing without stripping or irritating her skin.

concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report it helps reduce blackheads, clogged pores, and comedonal acne, with continued use over about two weeks leading to visibly fewer blemishes and no new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reports diverge by oil level: one reviewer with purely oily skin says the product simply doesn't work for him, since his skin's natural oil prevents it from pilling up, while others with hormonally oily or combination-oily skin say it helped reduce oiliness and pore congestion.

aspects.libelle: Pills up visibly, satisfying to watch dead skin roll off
A little goes a long way despite the higher price
Can be harder to rinse off completely than other peel shots
Sets quickly, so you must work fast to cover the face
Ingredient list not disclosed on the bottle
Dropper applicator allows precise, controlled dosing
Leaves a mild sticky feeling right after, fades by the next day

extraits.titre: Not my favorite peel, but did produce results.
extraits.texte: I've tried several peel shot products, starting with Dr. Melaxin and several other Korean made brands, so I knew what to expect but was hoping this would exceed my expectations for the price point. The packaging and design is great and I liked that Niacinimde was specifically called out, as this is an important active for me in my daily routine and I look for it in most cosmetics. I was disappointed, first in myself that I took it for face value without inspecting before purchase, then in the ingredient listing that it was nearly at the bottom. This product wasn't a great source of niacinimide compared to other alternatives. The peel was slow to form but did have decent results. Rinsing and removing all of the product and dead skin was more difficult than other brands, however. It creates a drag or like a friction on the skin which makes it difficult to really remove everything without adding more products for lubrication or further exfoliation. All in all, its not horrible but not one that I will purchase a second time over other peels.

extraits.titre: Skin type is important with this product!
extraits.texte: Normal, combo, or dry skin: This stuff is amazing! I have combo skin with a little bit of rosacea and this exfoliates without irritating my face at all! It comes out of the bottle like a serum and as you rub it on your face, it pills up and exfoliates. Oily skin: Doesn’t seem to work at all. My husband has oily skin and I tried it on him a couple times. I think the natural oiliness of his face combines with the serum, so the product isn’t able to pill up the way it should.

extraits.titre: CosRx Does It Again - Great Exfoliation for Dry and/or Mature Skin
extraits.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, mature skin, exfoliation is something I have to be very careful with. Too aggressive, and my skin shows it immediately. Too mild, and it doesn’t do enough to make a difference. This landed right in the middle for me. I’ve used peel shots from Dr. Melaxin and Tosowoong, so I went into this with pretty clear expectations. I’ve also had consistently good experiences with COSRX, which is why I was curious to try their version. This feels like a more balanced take on this type of product. It’s not harsh. It doesn’t feel like it’s stripping your skin or pushing it too far. Instead, it gives you that controlled exfoliation that removes buildup and smooths texture without leaving your skin tight or irritated afterward. For mature, dry skin, that matters. The texture and application are easy. It spreads evenly, works quickly, and rinses clean without leaving residue. It layers well into a routine and doesn’t interfere with the rest of my skincare. From an ingredient standpoint, this is focused on gentle exfoliation and skin-smoothing rather than aggressive resurfacing. The rice extract helps support a softer, more even look, while the overall formula is designed to refine texture without compromising the barrier. That balance is what makes it usable on a regular basis. I love Cosrx products, I have been using their products for ages. Especially their acne patches. I also have been having dry skin recent due to the weather changing, so the exfoliation is welcome. I am Korean, and have large pores, blackheads, and comedome acne (it is under the skin, so pimples thanks to clogged pores). My skin is generally oily and still is to a point. But the recent dryness is a thing. Usually, I use a peel shot exfoliator, it never occured to me that it could be in anything else. It looks like a standard serum and exfoliator with the eyedropper tool and all that. It might be cause I am sick while testing this, but it took me a moment to figure out if it is a serum and you put it on like a serum... or like a peel shot exfoliator. It is on the box, but I was still not entirely sure since anything you apply is generally after washing your face. I used it as an exfoliating peel. It is extremely lightweight and does feel more like a serum than a peel, but I was right in choosing. The exfoliation is very gentle and the fermented rice (and rice grains and rice water) have brightening properties. There aren't any rice bits in there, if you were wondering. The size is large, and it is easy on the skin. Overall, I do recommend this product for anyone who is looking for gentle but effective exfoliation. extraits.titre: Suitable for sensitive skin, gentle but effective exfoliation
extraits.texte: I have sensitive, rosacea prone skin that, due to changes in hormones, has become quite oily. I decided to try this exfoliating pore peel serum to try to keep my pores clean and reduce oiliness. I use a lot of COSRX products and it's a brand that I trust. The serum arrived in quite a large bottle with a dropper. After washing my face, I dropped a few drops on my hands and applied it to my face. The serum dries very quickly so you need to work fast if you want to cover your entire face. I focused mainly on my T-zone areas, working the serum in and rubbing gently. It was quite incredible to see the dead skin rolling off my face as I rubbed. Once I rinsed my face, it felt noticeably softer and smoother. It did leave a weird sticky feeling on my skin but that disappeared by the next day. I think this serum really works, but I would recommend anyone with sensitive skin to go slowly. I will only be using this once a week as I'm afraid of damaging my skin barrier, but will try to work up to twice a week if my skin can tolerate it.
